text: Figure 9.12: Interface for software update handling Name: UpdateRequest Technology: ara::com service interface Usage: Internal Description: This interface is intended to be used by Update and Configuration Management to interact with State Management to perform updates (including installation and removal) of Software Cluster s. PrepareRollback Prepares the affected Function Group s for a rollback. Operations: PrepareUpdate Prepares the affected Function Group s for an update. ▽
